'''Ōmushi Jinja''' (大虫神社) is the name of several {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines}}.

* {{ill|Ōmushi Shrine (Echizen)|ja|大虫神社}} - Located in Echizen City, Fukui Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōmushi Shrine (Yosano)|ja|大虫神社 (与謝野町)}} - Located in Yosano, Yosa District, Kyoto Prefecture.
